evals.prompt: Analyze the skill-creator SKILL and tell me if it needs evidence-chaining
evals.expected_output: Should generate an evaluation report analyzing skill-creator's document dependencies, existing anti-hallucination mechanisms, and provide transformation recommendations

evals.prompt: Transform a simple SKILL that reads a single knowledge file into evidence-chain mode
evals.expected_output: Should add anti-hallucination header to SKILL.md, apply content isolation to references, and add evidence protocol to workflow files that read documents

evals.prompt: I have a SKILL with workflows that read multiple documents. Add evidence chain support to it.
evals.expected_output: Should add multi-document evidence chain protocol with <evidence_chain> tags containing multiple <evidence> entries, one per document

evals.prompt: Check if the ts-code-compress skill needs evidence-chain transformation
evals.expected_output: Should analyze the SKILL, check for document dependencies, and determine if evidence-chaining is applicable (may not be needed if SKILL doesn't read external docs)

evals.prompt: Apply evidence-chain transformation to a router-style SKILL that dispatches to multiple workflows
evals.expected_output: Should add document isolation notice to router SKILL.md, and add evidence protocols to each sub-workflow that reads documents
